purpose: Audit the completed native magnetic-probe baseline for probe-placement validity after M3D-C1 explicitly reported the requested x=2.3,z=0 point outside the computational domain; establish the geometry/provenance boundary before any precursor analysis.

interpretation_contract.forbidden_substitution: Do not substitute Jpk, dJpk/dt, sheet width, generic flux/current scalars, or FAIR-MAST absolute milliseconds for a physically identified in-domain native magnetic probe.
interpretation_contract.claim_boundary: Normalized native M3D-C1 magnetic diagnostic geometry/provenance only; no precursor lead-time, controller-efficacy, experimental, or reactor-scale claim.
